placements.title: A platform switch rests on the basis it states for itself
placements.frame: What basis does a switch of data platform rest on, and is each stated reason evidenced, or only asserted?
placements.why: The position holds Dave Quantum's announcement of the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB switch with its stated rationale (10x query performance, lower licensing cost), and the memo's restatement of the migration as a decision, a performance gain, and a Q3 2026 timeline. Together these make the basis for a platform switch a recurring subject future envelopes can feed. The 10x figure and cost claim are asserted here without attached evidence, so the leaf's frame asks whether each basis is evidenced. No existing leaf was supplied, so the leaf is foundational and has no hub.
consulted: Thematic graph structure: none supplied (no existing leaves to reuse)
Grain test: the subject (basis of a platform switch) will keep receiving support; the 10x figure and Q3 timeline are facts evidencing it, not leaves
